message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick step‑by‑step guide so you can get those burgers and chicken wings delivered right to your door: --- ### 📲 How to Order Five Burgers & Six Chicken Wings from McDonald’s (Uber Eats) | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | **1️⃣ Open the App** | Launch the *Uber Eats* mobile app (iOS/Android) or visit [ubereats.com](https://www.uber.com/eat). | | **2️⃣ Sign In / Create Account** | Log into your existing account or sign up if you’re new. | | **3️⃣ Set Your Delivery Location** | Enter the street address where you’d like the meal delivered. Make sure the pin drops correctly on the map. | | **4️⃣ Search for “McDonald’s”** | Type “McDonald’s” into the search bar. If there are multiple locations nearby, pick the one that offers Uber Eats deliveries. | | **5️⃣ Browse the Menu** | Once inside the restaurant page, scroll through the menu categories. You’ll find items under “Burgers,” “Chicken,” “Sides,” etc. | | **6️⃣ Add Items to Cart** | • Tap each burger item → choose size/options → tap **Add to cart**.
• Repeat until you’ve added **five burgers**.

For the wings:
- Find “Chicken Wings” (often listed as “Wings” or “Spicy Wings”).
- Select the portion size that gives you roughly **six pieces** (most menus offer 8‑piece packs – you can adjust later).
- Add to cart. | | **7️⃣ Review Your Cart** | At the bottom left corner, tap the cart icon. Verify quantities: 5 burgers + 6 wings. Adjust if necessary. | | **8️⃣ Choose Payment Method** | Swipe to payment options. Pick credit/debit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Wallet, or add a new method. | | **9️⃣ Confirm Order** | Hit **Place Order**. A confirmation screen will show estimated arrival time (~30–45 minutes depending on distance). | | 🔟 Track It Live | Use the live tracker to see when the driver picks up the order and heads toward you. | --- #### Tips & Tricks - **Combo Deals:** Many McDonald’s restaurants bundle burgers with sides or drinks—check if there's a combo that includes wings too! - **Promo Codes:** Look for discount codes in the app before checkout to save $1–$5 off. - **Tip Wisely:** Adding a tip helps drivers stay motivated and may speed up service during busy times. - **Contactless Delivery:** Enable contactless pickup/delivery if you prefer minimal interaction. If you run into any hiccups while placing the order—or have special requests such as sauces or dietary restrictions—just hit the chat button within the app and let the support team help out. Enjoy your feast! 🍔🍗
